base.timing: Entire 255 greedy decode steps; prefill and prompt packing excluded; no profiler

protocol.definition: Decode 144 cools after attention; decode 145 first reads the cold block. 130-143 and 146-159 have matched hot lengths.
protocol.host_elapsed: Disjoint host function elapsed durations, including any CUDA API blocking or descheduling. No synchronization is inserted inside calls. CPU and GPU time must not be added.
protocol.thread_cpu: CPU time consumed by the calling thread inside the same functions; excludes waiting and work on other threads. Elapsed minus thread CPU is not necessarily GPU waiting.
protocol.instrumentation: Only append_hot, finish_decode_step, ensure_workspace are wrapped for decode 129-159. Two clocks and preallocated counters; no activity tracing, events or profiler callbacks.
protocol.control: Fresh identical generation/cache for each arm, alternating plain/timed and timed/plain. One warmup per arm, excluded. Window-boundary synchronization is identical in both arms.
protocol.perturbation_policy: Absolute paired median wall difference <=3% for multi-step windows, <=5% for single-step windows. Negative differences indicate timing variability. This is an empirical check, not proof of zero instrumentation bias.
